answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 151468 Country: India Title: Is it makrooh if we don't wear cap apart from salah? As I am working in company, there is no rules here like not to wear cap. Question: Is it makrooh if we don't wear cap apart from salah? As I am working in company, there is no rules here like not to wear cap. Answer ID: 151468 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1071/955/H=9/1438) Although there is no rule of the company but the rule of Shariah is that it is makrooh to develop the habit of remaining bare-head as well as it is against etiquettes. It is also against the practice of pious and God-fearing people that continues since more than 1400 years. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
